name: galaxy_fork
description: Fork an existing galaxy partition into a new sovereign galaxy branch (e.g. 'guide' -> 'project-alpha').

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Source galaxy name to fork from (e.g. 'guide')

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Target galaxy name to establish (e.g. 'project-alpha')

name: galaxy_list
description: List all active sovereign memory galaxies, their record counts, sample tags, and starter guide status.

name: memory_get
description: Retrieve an exact evidence record from the Substrate by its numeric ID or UUID string.

arguments.name: id
arguments.desc: The unique numerical record ID (u64) or UUID string

name: memory_recall
description: Recall memories matching a query from the sovereign Gen3 Substrate using BM25, anchor coherence, and forgotten diamond recovery.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search query terms or phrase

arguments.name: historical
arguments.desc: Include superseded or historical records (default: false)

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Optional recall scope filter

name: memory_remember
description: Record a new memory into the sovereign Gen3 Substrate via CommitCapability and sovereign pulse compilation.

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Content of the memory to record

arguments.name: kind
arguments.desc: Epistemic kind: reported (default), system, or simulated

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Epistemic provenance attribution (default: 'agent:mcp')

arguments.name: uuid
arguments.desc: Optional explicit UUID to bind to the new record

name: memory_stats
description: Inspect Substrate statistics, current epoch, record count, and sovereign invariants.

name: mesh_sync
description: Synchronize the local Substrate with a remote Mandala P2P mesh peer node over TCP.

arguments.name: peer
arguments.desc: IP:port or host:port address of the remote peer (e.g. '127.0.0.1:7369')

arguments.name: batch_size
arguments.desc: Maximum records to sync per request (default: 100)

name: session_checkpoint
description: Record a compounding structured checkpoint for agent session continuity across turns and handoffs.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session identifier (e.g. conversation ID, lane name)

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: High-density summary of decisions, state, and findings

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: Active agent identifier (default: 'agent')

arguments.name: checkpoint_type
arguments.desc: Checkpoint type: 'turn', 'handoff', 'milestone', 'compact'

arguments.name: context_token
arguments.desc: Optional ContextCache token for prefix cache stabilization

arguments.name: corrections
arguments.desc: Operator or tool corrections ledger

arguments.name: crystallize
arguments.desc: Optional: crystallize converged session decisions into a linked codex memory record (default false)

arguments.name: identity_invariants
arguments.desc: Identity and behavioral invariants

arguments.name: lessons
arguments.desc: Distilled episodic lessons from this session

arguments.name: next_queue
arguments.desc: Queued action items for next turn / next agent

arguments.name: open_flags
arguments.desc: Open flags, blockers, or warnings

arguments.name: relational_context
arguments.desc: Longitudinal relational context with the operator or peer agents

name: session_continuity
description: Retrieve the latest compounding session continuity state, summary, action queue, and related track crystals for an agent session.

arguments.name: current_session_id
arguments.desc: Optional active session identifier to exclude when selecting a prior session

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Optional session identifier filter; if omitted, returns the latest checkpoint across all sessions

arguments.name: token_budget
arguments.desc: Optional cap for compact agent_context.text: UTF-8 byte cap is token_budget × 4; estimated_tokens is a byte-based heuristic, not tokenizer-guaranteed. Zero produces empty context. Newest checkpoint summary and next_queue are reserved first; if they cannot fit, budget_completeness is insufficient and text is empty.

arguments.name: track
arguments.desc: Optional track slug to surface prior crystallized codex memories and select the latest prior session on this track

name: session_list
description: List all unique session identifiers recorded in the substrate.

name: session_record
description: Record an arbitrary log entry, note, or observation tied to a session.

arguments.name: content
arguments.desc: Log content text

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session identifier

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: Agent identifier (default: 'agent')

arguments.name: log_type
arguments.desc: Log type (e.g. 'note', 'tool_output', 'decision')

arguments.name: qualifier
arguments.desc: Epistemic qualifier for this turn

arguments.name: resolves
arguments.desc: DiAML turn id of an earlier question, proposal, or hypothesis this turn resolves

arguments.name: supersedes
arguments.desc: Turn id of an earlier turn this record replaces

name: sutra_canon
description: Inspect the canonical 12-glyph logoglyphic Sutra canon, alchemical dual-mappings, Taoist hand seals (印诀), and bound Action Skeletons.

name: sutra_cast
description: Evaluate and dispatch a zero-allocation Taoist Hand Seal / Sutra Codon (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal'). Validates preconditions, computes Kekkai sandbox boundaries, and executes bound Action Skeleton cycles or transmits swarm mudra packet to P2P peer.

arguments.name: codon
arguments.desc: Logoglyphic Sutra codon or Taoist hand seal sequence (e.g. '觀 證 行', 'Kek-01-Seal', '根 界 息')

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.desc: Alias for !execute; if true, only validates preconditions and returns deterministic plan

arguments.name: execute
arguments.desc: Whether to execute the bound Action Skeleton against the substrate (default: false / dry-run)

arguments.name: peer
arguments.desc: Target peer address (e.g. '152.53.195.47:7369') for remote Swarm Mudra Handoff via Wire Protocol 7369

arguments.name: resolves
arguments.desc: Optional DiAML turn ID resolved by this Sutra execution (defaults to latest open arc when omitted)

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Optional session ID to record the executed Sutra DiAML turn into

arguments.name: strict
arguments.desc: Fails closed if preconditions (read-only, landlock, mesh net) are unsatisfied

arguments.name: track
arguments.desc: Optional track slug for the recorded Sutra turn

name: sutra_compile
description: Compile high-level natural language intent into an optimal compound Sutra codon and Taoist Mudra formula using static Model2Vec embeddings or lexical centroids.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: High-level natural language intent or task description to compile into a Sutra codon

name: sutra_contract
description: Resolve or verify bounded caller-asserted temporal assertions. Results describe the supplied metadata; this tool does not authenticate sources or enforce native-store sanctuary access.

arguments.name: assertions
arguments.desc: Caller-asserted records with record_id, source_id, subject, predicate, value, valid_from, valid_until, recorded_at, supersedes; exclude when request_json is supplied

arguments.name: attest
arguments.desc: Return an unsigned SHA-256 digest binding the operation, exact request bytes and result; not a signature or CPR receipt

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: Contract operation: resolve assertions into facts/citations or verify a candidate proposal (default: resolve)

arguments.name: proposal
arguments.desc: Candidate proposal object (for verify mode) with status and claims array

arguments.name: question
arguments.desc: Question object with question_id, query, subject, predicate, valid_at (array of dates), and known_at cutoff

arguments.name: request_json
arguments.desc: Full raw request JSON; mutually exclusive with assertions, question and proposal

name: sutra_hexagram
description: Inspect or mutate one of the 64 King Wen I Ching Hexagram Macro-Actions. Returns King Wen number, binary symbol, trigrams, Wu Xing element, default codon, nuclear inner, complement (反), reverse (覆), and dynamic line mutation transformations.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Hexagram name, pinyin, King Wen number (1-64), or Unicode symbol (e.g. '既济', 'Qian', '1', '䷾')

arguments.name: mutate_line
arguments.desc: Optional line number (1 to 6, bottom to top) to mutate (flip yin/yang) and compute resulting hexagram and codon

name: sutra_list
description: List all recognized canonical compound Taoist Mudras (印诀式), their formulaic compositions, preconditions, and primary execution skeletons.

name: sutra_route
description: Route an inquiry or task intent through the Catuṣkoṭi K3 dialectical cognitive router. Employs Kleene 3-valued logic to resolve dialectical tensions (competing action vectors like execute vs dry-run) and matches 64-hexagram macro-actions, returning System 0/1/2 triage tier, resting potential, plasticity, and bound Action Skeleton.

arguments.name: inquiry
arguments.desc: Task description, inquiry, or hexagram name to route

arguments.name: utility
arguments.desc: Expected marginal utility threshold (default: 0.8)

name: wm
description: WhiteMagic unified meta-tool — routes natural language (thought), explicit routes (route), or discrete actions over the sovereign Gen3 kernel.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: Legacy action selector: recall, remember, get, stats, sync, sweep, inspect, session_checkpoint, session_continuity, session_record, session_list, galaxy_list, galaxy_fork, sutra_cast, sutra_compile, sutra_canon, sutra_list, sangha.claim, sangha.release, sangha.occupied, sangha.rooms, sangha.epoch, sangha.vcs, sangha.fork, sangha.consolidate

arguments.name: args
arguments.desc: Arguments to pass through to target tool

arguments.name: route
arguments.desc: Explicit tool name or route for direct dispatch (e.g. 'memory.search', 'session.continuity', 'sangha.claim', 'sangha.vcs', 'sangha.fork')

arguments.name: thought
arguments.desc: Natural language request auto-routed via TF-IDF NLU
